title: Shrink fat zoom highlights + green auto-highlight
description:
Highlights that got massively thick after rapid Viewer zoom are snapped back to normal thickness on load (stored widths above 16 reset to 10). Auto-highlight lines now use green instead of the board yellow/color-picker color.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Builder / Viewer on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh Plan Sync. Fat lines should look normal again; re-run Auto Highlight to regenerate pipes in green (existing auto lines are also recolored on load).
changeLog: Heal inflated highlight stroke widths left by the zoom projection bug.
Cap Viewer zoom contribution to stroke painting so thickness cannot explode.
DB3 auto-highlight color is fixed green (#3ddc84).
